I will stay close to what worked for me last season, but I will put a little money into seed and some fertilizer because this is my own land and I need a better maize harvest. I do not have enough cash to farm heavily with chemicals, and here in Mtwara I do not depend on irrigation, so I will use family labor for most of the work and only hire a few people when planting and weeding are too much. I will also use some manure where I can get it, because buying everything from the shop is hard for me.
